note: Order sizing is event-inflated by design, so accuracy is scored on realised supply and logistics plus the Demand Agent's held-out WAPE, never on a snapshot cover comparison.

learning_curve.note: Monthly WAPE of the loop's weekly seasonal-naive forecast read against realised sales, over the full 36-month walk. The spread is the seasonal discovery signal: the peak-demand months (Ramadan / Lebaran / year-end) carry the highest error, the quiet months the lowest.
